purpose: Development demonstration only. These files are not field observations and must not be mixed into production or staging.
class_assignment_policy: A class is recorded only after a person looked at the stored image. Orientation relative to the visible direction of travel was required for D00 and D10. Images that did not show one dominant class were left out.
